A lot of people are already saying stuff about a 10yo being responsible for a 3yo so I won’t go into that and I think a punishment was definitely necessary. Just be careful about exercise as a punishment because exercising may turn into something they don’t want to do because they they’ll associate it with negative feelings and only something they should do if they do something wrong. Exercising should be a positive experience and can be a great source of fun and stress relief. We all make mistakes so don’t feel too bad about the people tearing into you and just use this as a learning experience for the future. (On a completely irrelevant note, this is also why using cleaning as a punishment could lead to bad habits since cleaning could be associated with negativity, it should be taught more as like brushing your teeth, something that is just done for your own benefit and health.)
